movie.title: Claressa Shields vs. Kaye Scott
movie.overview: Having collected the belts at heavyweight, the 'GWOAT' Claressa Shields (18-0) returns to the middleweight division, taking on WBA and WBC world champion Kaye Scott (5-1-1) in a thrilling Atlanta main event.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Undefeated boxing champion Claressa Shields moves back to middleweight to challenge world champion Kaye Scott in a high-stakes title fight in Atlanta.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After conquering the heavyweight division, Claressa 'GWOAT' Shields returns to her home weight class of middleweight with her sights set on more gold. Standing in her way is WBA and WBC world champion Kaye Scott, who aims to derail the undefeated superstar's historic run. Set against the vibrant backdrop of Atlanta, this main event showdown tests the limits, skill, and resilience of both elite fighters. The bout promises high-octane action and intense drama as both women battle for dominance and boxing legacy.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Claressa Shields enters the ring boasting an impressive undefeated 18-0 record, having successfully moved up in weight to capture titles in the heavyweight division. Eager to reaffirm her self-proclaimed status as the 'GWOAT' (Greatest Woman of All Time), she makes a dramatic return to the middleweight ranks. Her opponent, Kaye Scott, holds the prestigious WBA and WBC world champion belts with a solid 5-1-1 record and a reputation for tough, technical skill. Scott enters the contest determined to shock the sports world by taking down one of boxing's most dominant figures. Hosted as a major main event in Atlanta, the bout draws massive attention from fight fans and commentators alike. As the bell rings, both fighters display their unique styles—Shields with her blistering speed and relentless offense, and Scott with her tactical counter-punching and ring control. The fight escalates round by round, pushing both athletes to their physical and psychological limits. Drama unfolds both inside and outside the ring as strategic adjustments and sheer willpower determine every exchange. Ultimately, the contest serves as a definitive chapter in the evolution of women's combat sports.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Claressa Shields vs. Kaye Scott captures the electric intensity of a high-stakes world championship boxing match in Atlanta. Claressa Shields, holding a flawless 18-0 record and fresh off a dominant campaign at heavyweight, drops back down to middleweight to reclaim her throne. She faces Kaye Scott (5-1-1), the reigning WBA and WBC world champion who is eager to solidify her own legacy by handing Shields her first career loss. This sports showcase highlights the grit, preparation, and tactical warfare required at the highest level of professional boxing, offering audiences a dramatic front-row seat to an unforgettable championship clash.
